title: hydrangea macrophylla f. caerulea
intro: Hydrangea macrophylla f. caerulea, commonly known as the bigleaf blue hydrangea, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Hydrangeaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating pain, due to its therapeutic actions as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Hydrangea macrophylla f. caerulea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for therapeutic purposes.
